tools.name: connect
tools.description: Connect to a MySQL database using a connection string. The connection will be used for subsequent queries until changed.

tools.name: disconnect
tools.description: Disconnect from the current runtime database and revert to the default environment-configured connection

tools.name: query
tools.description: Run a read-only SQL query against the currently connected database

connectionString.description: Optional: MySQL connection string to override the current connection for this query only
